sources.title: Chiappa Rhino Instruction Manual (revolver range specifications)

weapons.name: AR-31 Bolt-action Rifle
weapons.source_note: ArmaLite 2015 catalog, AR-31 page (PART #: 31BT308): "Caliber: 7.62x51 MM/.308 ... Twist: 1:10\" RH". States a right-hand 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Rhino 50Ds Double-action/single-action revolver
weapons.source_note: Chiappa Rhino instruction manual, "The Rhino revolver range" table: "340.220 50DS Mag 5\" 12,7 9\"1/2 24 6 1 X 19 in 895 gr 1,97 6 Black - wooden grips". States the .357 Magnum (Mag) 50DS has 6 grooves and a 1 turn in 19 inch twist = 482.6 mm per turn.
